title: How provider records become canonical providers
desc: Provider records arrive from many sources under different names. Blocking keeps comparisons among records that share a key. Embedding similarity with FAISS proposes candidate pairs inside each block, an LLM decides each candidate pair, and graph clustering turns accepted pairs into canonical providers. A separate LLM cascade then writes a description for each provider, sending the hardest cases to grounded search.
caption: The entity-resolution pipeline behind the Credential Value Index.
